description:
About our brand and products

Cellutrex is a clean hydration brand built for real life. We make no-junk electrolyte drink mixes using high-quality ingredients, zero sugar, and nothing artificial. Our products are designed to help people stay hydrated, energized, and feeling their best — whether they’re training, working long days, traveling, or just trying to drink more water.

What makes us different

We don’t believe in shortcuts. Cellutrex uses ancient cave salt electrolytes, thoughtful formulations, and third-party testing to deliver hydration that actually works — without the fillers, dyes, or sugar found in many other brands. We’re focused on quality, transparency, and building a brand people genuinely trust and enjoy using every day.

How affiliates can earn

Affiliates earn commissions for every purchase made through their unique referral link. Share Cellutrex with your audience, friends, or community — when they buy, you earn. All sales, clicks, and commissions are tracked in your affiliate dashboard so you can easily see your impact and earnings.

How to promote us

Affiliates can promote Cellutrex however feels most natural to them — social media posts, reels, stories, blogs, emails, or word-of-mouth. We encourage authentic content that shows how you actually use Cellutrex in your daily life. We also provide brand assets and guidance to make sharing easy.

Other information

We welcome affiliates of all sizes — you don’t need a massive following to join. What matters most is authenticity and alignment with our brand values. Our team is here to support you, answer questions, and help you succeed as part of the Cellutrex Affiliate Team.


Affiliate Commission Tiers

💧 Hydration Rookie — 10% Commission

$0–$999 in referred sales

Just getting started? You’ll earn 10% commission on every sale you refer. Perfect for new affiliates sharing Cellutrex with friends, family, or a growing audience.

💦 Hydration Veteran — 15% Commission

$1,000–$2,499 in referred sales

You’re gaining momentum! Once you hit $1,000 in total referred sales, your commission increases to 15%. More effort, more impact, more earnings.

🔥 Hydration Pro — 20% Commission

$2,500+ in referred sales

Top-tier status unlocked. Affiliates who reach $2,500+ in referred sales earn our highest commission rate at 20% — because consistent results deserve serious rewards.
payout_period: Payouts occur on the 15th of each month, based on the previous months paid sales.
